================================================================================
variable reference
================================================================================

locals {
  x = some_var
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (variable_expr
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
attribute access
================================================================================

locals {
  x = var.region
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (expression
            (variable_expr
              (identifier)))
          (get_attr
            name: (identifier)))))))

================================================================================

  x = (1 + 2)
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (paren_expr
            (expression
              (operation
                (binary_operation
                  left: (expression
                    (literal_value
                      (numeric_lit)))
                  right: (expression
                    (literal_value
                      (numeric_lit))))))))))))

                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================

================================================================================

  x = !true
}

  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (unary_operation

                (literal_value
